property_summary: For any admissible (timestamp, block number) pair, after a successful fallback call C's public pastBlockTime() must equal the block.timestamp of that call; the mutant stores block.number instead, so any input with timestamp != block.number breaks the rule.
change_summary: Replace the assignment `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so the stored value differs from P after any successful call.
